title: Yellowed Smoky Japanese Squid Noodles
description: A smoky and creamy Japanese dish featuring squid, perfect for a lazy Sunday, with a paleo-friendly twist.

ingredients.name: Squid
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the squid and cook for 2 minutes, or until browned.
Add the coconut milk and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, or until the squid is cooked through.
While the squid is cooking, cook the shirataki noodles according to the package instructions.
Drain the noodles and add them to the skillet with the squid mixture.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve.
